title: Polyoxometalate-based all-inorganic open frameworks
claim: Polyoxoniobate all-inorganic frameworks remain scarce because soluble PONb precursors are lacking and the chemistry is constrained to strongly alkaline conditions.
explanation: Section 3.1 contrasts the small set of PONb frameworks with the broader Mo, V, and W families. The tabulated examples are limited to a K/Na-linked {VNb14} framework and three alkaline-earth-linked {Nb10} frameworks whose channels contain tetramethylammonium.
scope: All-inorganic open frameworks based on polyoxoniobate SBUs.
conditions: Strongly alkaline reaction media; the {Nb10} series uses Ca2+, Sr2+, or Ba2+ linkers with TMA countercations.
caveats: The scarcity is a literature-status statement in this review, not a proof that PONb frameworks are intrinsically impossible outside alkaline conditions.
